Hi Stephanie / Marcus,

Thanks again for the quick responses on the call yesterday. Gridly would like to do an in-person demo at Redwood HQ the week of July 20 if that still works for you. A few details so we can align: 

- Preferred days: Tue 7/22 or Wed 7/23, morning preferred (between 9–11am).
- Headcount: 6 (3 product, 2 engineering, 1 security).
- We need a signed visitor NDA in advance and a parking pass if possible.
- AV needs: HDMI + laptop dongle; we may bring a MacBook Pro.

Attaching our internal guest list and a scanned copy of the Gridly corporate insurance card (attached).

Thanks — Ari

2) We have two conference rooms that fit 6 comfortably with AV: Maple-3 (ground floor, closest to lobby) and Cedar-1 (2nd floor; quieter). Marcus is looping in IT to confirm HDMI and dongle availability.
3) I attached our Redwood HQ Visitor Guide and a standard Visitor NDA we ask guests to sign ahead of the visit. Please have your security team complete the NDA and return via DocuSign link below.

Proposed time: 10:00–12:00 on 7/22 (demo + follow-up Q&A). If that conflicts with flights, we can shift to 9:00 start.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/XYZ-Gridly-NDA
Calendar hold (tentative): https://go.redwood.ai/calendar/evt/abcd1234

Thanks all — quick ops note from Redwood Facilities / IT: 

- Room: Maple-3 reserved for 7/22 09:00–13:00 pending final confirmation. It has a wall-mounted 4K display, HDMI cable, and an Apple USB-C dongle on the AV cart. Marcus (me) will be onsite to greet and do a mic check.
- Escort: Front-desk escort is standard for external guests; Laura will be the primary escort and will meet you at the lobby.
- Badges: Front desk can pre-print visitor badges if we have the full list 48 hours before arrival.
- Parking: We can issue 2 visitor passes reserved in Lot B; additional guests can use street parking or the public garage across Redwood Way.
- Security checklist: government ID for all guests, signed Visitor NDA, and COI on file. Gridly already sent COI — good to have that included in the file.

I'll create the final calendar invite and include the front-desk instructions once we have names.

Marcus Lin

Calendar invite will be sent from my account shortly with the updated time and location. If anything else pops up (flight change, extra attendees), reply to this thread and we'll update.

Safe travels — see you on Thursday!
